evidence_direction_note: MECH-439 F-dominance conflict-grade GAP-BLIND control-arm falsifier -- supersedes V3-EXQ-689 (same scientific question, redesigned measurement). 689 self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on the grading-non-vacuity gap-spread precondition (gap_spread 0/3; F-gap pinned in the near-tie bin; the per-gap-bin C_FGAP regression uncomputable). ADJUDICATED (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-689_2026-06-19) as a test-design/measurement gap, NOT substrate-under-trained: GAP-A readiness PASSED + both levers ENGAGED (k 3/3, t_eff 3/3); the gap is structurally near-tie-pinned (itself a manifestation of the F-dominance MECH-439 asserts). 689a replaces the uncomputable regression with a GAP-BLIND ARM CONTRAST: ARM_A1B1 (gap-SCALED both levers) must beat BOTH gap-blind controls -- ARM_FIXED_KMAX (flat k=6) AND ARM_FIXED_HOT_T (flat T=2.5 over the divergent e2_world_forward source) -- on committed-action class entropy on >=2/3 seeds (C_GAPBLIND, load-bearing). PASS (label=conflict_grade_converts_committed_diversity) = READINESS (IN-ARM route-range + e2-divergence + levers-engaged k/T_eff-vary; gap-spread DECOUPLED) AND C_PRIMARY (strict-above both collapsed controls) AND C_GAPBLIND. Route/e2-div below floor OR k/T_eff not varied self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory, NEVER a weakens). Readiness met, no lift vs collapsed => conversion_ceiling_persists_despite_conflict_grade (V4 off-ramp). Readiness + lift but a gap-blind control matches it => uniform_lift_grading_non_load_bearing (a bigger fixed shortlist / hotter flat softmax, NOT conflict-grading -> rank_preserving_F_to_eligibility_demotion). Quantile-adaptive gap binning + the fixed-width regression are SECONDARY readouts (c_fgap_secondary), NON-GATING. NO weakens path. claim_ids=[MECH-439] only; ARC-065/MECH-341/ARC-062/MECH-309/MECH-294 untouched.
